final: WITH operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, SUM(scancount) AS scans_done, AVG(1.0 * gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS gb_per_min FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(gb_per_min) AS all_operator_gb_per_min FROM operator_stats) SELECT AVG(scans_done) AS avg_scans_done, AVG(gb_per_min) AS avg_gb_per_min, AVG(gb_per_min - all_operator_gb_per_min) AS avg_excess_gb_per_min FROM operator_stats CROSS JOIN benchmark WHERE gb_per_min > all_operator_gb_per_min
